title: Walk in Love, Wives and Husbands

questions.question: Therefore be ____ of God, as beloved children.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:1 (ESV): "Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children."

questions.question: And walk in love, as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant ____ and sacrifice to God.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:2 (ESV): "And walk in love, as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God."

questions.question: Let there be no filthiness nor foolish talk nor crude joking, which are out of place, but instead let there be ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:4 (ESV): "Let there be no filthiness nor foolish talk nor crude joking, which are out of place, but instead let there be thanksgiving."

questions.question: You may be sure of this, that everyone who is sexually immoral or impure, or who is covetous (that is, an ____), has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:5 (ESV): "For you may be sure of this, that everyone who is sexually immoral or impure, or who is covetous (that is, an idolater), has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God."

questions.question: For at one time you were darkness, but now you are ____ in the Lord. Walk as children of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:8 (ESV): "for at one time you were darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light"

questions.question: Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but instead ____ them.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:11 (ESV): "Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but instead expose them."

questions.question: Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, making the best use of the ____, because the days are evil.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:15-16 (ESV): "Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, making the best use of the time, because the days are evil."

questions.question: And do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery, but be filled with the ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:18 (ESV): "And do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit,"

questions.question: Addressing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making ____ to the Lord with your heart.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:19 (ESV): "addressing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody to the Lord with your heart,"

questions.question: Giving thanks always and for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, ____ to one another out of reverence for Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:20-21 (ESV): "giving thanks always and for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ."

questions.question: Wives, submit to your own husbands, as to the ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:22 (ESV): "Wives, submit to your own husbands, as to the Lord."

questions.question: Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the ____ and gave himself up for her.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:25 (ESV): "Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her,"

questions.question: Christ gave himself up for the church, that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:26 (ESV): "that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,"

questions.question: In the same way husbands should love their wives as their own ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:28 (ESV): "In the same way husbands should love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself."

questions.question: Paul quotes Genesis: "Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and hold fast to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh." He says this mystery is profound, and it refers to Christ and the ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:31-32 (ESV): "'Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and hold fast to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.' This mystery is profound, and I am saying that it refers to Christ and the church."

key_verse_text: Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, making the best use of the time, because the days are evil.
